dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible as multiple light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters on a dark background. The three most prominent structures show a sharp high-contrast gradient from the dark pelage to a thin, light-gray exterior ring, with a return to low-intensity pixels in the center core. Edge geometry is generally circular but exhibits micro-irregularities and varying line thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of light-pixel clusters in the mid-section, where the annuli are most concentrated. Individual high-intensity pixel cores are localized within the boundaries of the ring structures, appearing most densely packed in the central-lateral region and thinning toward the anterior and posterior extremities.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli in the mid-body form a scalene triangle. The distance between the central-most annulus and the one immediately posterior is approximately 1.5 times the distance to the adjacent ventral-lateral annulus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-brown, high-texture area is visible on the ventral-lateral midline, indicating localized physical trauma or a lesion that disrupts the standard pigment and texture of the skin.
other_distinctive_markers: Several annuli exhibit a 'chain' pattern where the light perimeters overlap or fuse, creating a complex, interconnected high-contrast lattice rather than isolated circular structures.
